التصقن (form VIII)
# اِلْتَصَقْنَ (iltaṣaqna) /il.ta.sˤaq.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِلْتَصَقَ (iltaṣaqa)
# اِلْتَصِقْنَ (iltaṣiqna) /il.ta.sˤiq.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِلْتَصَقَ (iltaṣaqa)
